title: Divergence of the vector field of a pulled-back n-form: trace DΦ(v) = dω(G(v))(DG(v)e_0, …, DG(v)e_n) on D
statement:
Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let D ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} be open, let G : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P be C² on D, and let ω : ℝ^P → Λ^n(ℝ^P) be a C^∞ differential n-form (values: continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P).

Let e_0, …, e_n be the standard basis of ℝ^{n+1}, DG(v) the derivative of G at v, and j.succAbove the increasing enumeration of {0, …, n} ∖ {j}. Define Φ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^{n+1} by Φ(v) := Σ_{j=0}^{n} (−1)^j ω(G(v))(DG(v)e_{j.succAbove 0}, …, DG(v)e_{j.succAbove(n−1)})·e_j for v ∈ D, and Φ(v) := 0 for v ∉ D.

Then for every v ∈ D, trace DΦ(v) = dω(G(v))(DG(v)e_0, …, DG(v)e_n), where d is the exterior derivative (SimonGMT exteriorDerivative = Mathlib extDeriv).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (G : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (Φ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)), IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 G D → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ω → Φ = D.indicator (fun v => ∑ j : Fin (n + 1), ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ) * ω (G v) (fun k => fderiv ℝ G v (EuclideanSpace.single (j.succAbove k) 1))) • EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) → ∀ v ∈ D, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (n + 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ v : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)) = exteriorDerivative ω (G v) (fun i => fderiv ℝ G v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))
